localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
This group camp area has a minimum occupancy of 20 people and a maximum of 75 people. Groups with over 75 people may have part or all of their group cited and evicted. Groups are allowed a maximum of 25 vehicles total. The 25 vehicles may not fit in the group camp parking area; offsite parking is available. Up to 4 of the total vehicles may include RVs, and no utility hookups are available. RVs must fit in the group camp parking stalls.
This group camping area offers a tree-filled lawn area ideal for tents. It has a covered kitchen area with electrical outlets for kitchen use only, 2 barbeques, a fire ring with seating for use when campfires are permitted, and a 2-sided modern restroom with a flush toilet and sink on either side. Showers are available in the main campground restroom, about a 5-minute walk.
